## Comparison

**Doctor**
- Pose: crossed arms — matches ✅
- Clothing: white coat, stethoscope — matches ✅ (render adds a tie/shirt, mockup shows blue scrubs collar — minor)
- Hair: dark, short — matches ✅
- Expression: friendly smile, open eyes — matches ✅

**Mini hospital**
- White building, black cross, blue windows, gray doors — matches ✅
- Render hospital is slightly taller/more detailed windows; structure and placement (left of doctor) match

**Green bushes**
- Blob-style green bushes at base and sides — matches ✅ (render adds a full tree on the right — slight addition)
- Left bushes cluster style differs a bit: mockup has two round blobs, render has many small spheres

**Layout / background / style**
- Doctor right-of-center, hospital left, bushes around base — matches ✅
- Light gray/white plain background — matches ✅
- 3D cartoon render style — matches ✅

**Text check:** No text or UI artifacts in the render. ✅

## Scores

| Criterion | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Silhouette | 0.9 | Same composition; extra tree alters right edge |
| Details | 0.9 | Coherent hospital, stethoscope, bushes; minor style drift |
| Colors | 1.0 | Palette matches exactly |
| **Overall** | **0.93** | Faithful recreation |

## Brief fixes
- Remove the standalone tree on the right edge
- Make left-side bushes larger/two-blob like mockup
- Shorten hospital slightly; keep windows simpler
